Name: Marlon's Full Recovery
Author: wyeedo643
Description:
[size=5][b]Marlon's Full Recovery[/b][/size]

[i]Recover everything you lost. / 找回你失去的一切。[/i]

[size=4][b]About / 简介[/b][/size]

English: In vanilla Stardew Valley, after you pass out in the Mines, Skull Cavern, or Volcano Dungeon, Marlon only lets you recover ONE lost item (or one stack); the rest are gone forever. This mod removes that limit — recover ALL of your lost items, with extra options.

中文: 原版星露谷里，你在矿洞 / 骷髅洞 / 火山地牢晕倒后，只能从马龙那里赎回一件丢失物（或一叠），其余永久消失。本模组去掉了这个限制——可赎回任意多件，并支持更多选项。

[size=4][b]Features / 功能[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Recover all lost items（多件赎回）[/*]
[*]One-at-a-time redemption（逐个赎回）[/*]
[*]Progressive pricing, optional（递增价格）[/*]
[*]Accumulate losses across deaths, optional（累积丢失物）[/*]
[*]Configurable recovery fee（手续费可配置）[/*]
[*]Redeem-all button（一键全部赎回）[/*]
[*]Inventory-full guard（背包满拦截）[/*]
[*]HUD messages（赎回提示）[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu support（GMCM 支持）[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation / 安装[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI (4.0.0 or higher).[/*]
[*]Unzip and put the "MarlonsFullRecovery" folder into Stardew Valley/Mods/.[/*]
[*]Launch the game.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Configuration / 配置[/b][/size]

A config.json is generated on first run. With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, configure via Title screen → Settings → Mod Options.

[size=4][b]Credits / 鸣谢[/b][/size]

Inspired by LunarDiver's Item Recovery Plus — the first mod to allow recovering more than one item from Marlon — but that mod has been unmaintained since 2022 and is incompatible with Stardew Valley 1.6. This is a from-scratch rewrite for 1.6 (built by decompiling the game itself, not by copying its code).

[size=4][b]About this mod's creation / 制作说明[/b][/size]

This mod's code, decompilation analysis, and automated testing were largely assisted by an AI assistant (WorkBuddy), with wyeedo643 providing the idea and requirements. Sincere thanks to the AI assistant for doing most of the work. This mod was developed with AI assistance.

[size=4][b]Compatibility / 兼容性[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x + SMAPI 4.x (developed and tested on 1.6.15).[/*]
[*]Minimal-invasive Harmony patch; does not modify saves or game files.[/*]
[/list]
